zh.If you enable the microphone, your first: If you enable the microphone, your first character transformation samples your voice on your device for 5 seconds. Volume and pitch produce a playful personal scariness score, saved per character in this browser; ordinary exploration does not save or upload raw audio. This is a game score, not a measurement of fear. For invitations, your nickname, average and peak pitch, game level and response time are shared with the inviter. When you unlock an invitation visit, the unlock confirmation explains that watching the invited transformation records two seconds and automatically uploads the recording and local game score for the inviter alone to play. The server uses your existing nickname, the inviter’s link label, or your guest identifier; no name entry is required. These labels are not verified SNS identities. Other microphone pitch checks store numeric results only. Silence and unclear sound are marked as unmeasured. Microphone access is required to unlock play. Confirm the brief gameplay and microphone notice after tapping unlock; there is no separate invitation consent form.

ar.If you enable the microphone, your first: If you enable the microphone, your first character transformation samples your voice on your device for 5 seconds. Volume and pitch produce a playful personal scariness score, saved per character in this browser; ordinary exploration does not save or upload raw audio. This is a game score, not a measurement of fear. For invitations, your nickname, average and peak pitch, game level and response time are shared with the inviter. When you unlock an invitation visit, the unlock confirmation explains that watching the invited transformation records two seconds and automatically uploads the recording and local game score for the inviter alone to play. The server uses your existing nickname, the inviter’s link label, or your guest identifier; no name entry is required. These labels are not verified SNS identities. Other microphone pitch checks store numeric results only. Silence and unclear sound are marked as unmeasured. Microphone access is required to unlock play. Confirm the brief gameplay and microphone notice after tapping unlock; there is no separate invitation consent form.

th.If you enable the microphone, your first: If you enable the microphone, your first character transformation samples your voice on your device for 5 seconds. Volume and pitch produce a playful personal scariness score, saved per character in this browser; ordinary exploration does not save or upload raw audio. This is a game score, not a measurement of fear. For invitations, your nickname, average and peak pitch, game level and response time are shared with the inviter. When you unlock an invitation visit, the unlock confirmation explains that watching the invited transformation records two seconds and automatically uploads the recording and local game score for the inviter alone to play. The server uses your existing nickname, the inviter’s link label, or your guest identifier; no name entry is required. These labels are not verified SNS identities. Other microphone pitch checks store numeric results only. Silence and unclear sound are marked as unmeasured. Microphone access is required to unlock play. Confirm the brief gameplay and microphone notice after tapping unlock; there is no separate invitation consent form.

vi.If you enable the microphone, your first: If you enable the microphone, your first character transformation samples your voice on your device for 5 seconds. Volume and pitch produce a playful personal scariness score, saved per character in this browser; ordinary exploration does not save or upload raw audio. This is a game score, not a measurement of fear. For invitations, your nickname, average and peak pitch, game level and response time are shared with the inviter. When you unlock an invitation visit, the unlock confirmation explains that watching the invited transformation records two seconds and automatically uploads the recording and local game score for the inviter alone to play. The server uses your existing nickname, the inviter’s link label, or your guest identifier; no name entry is required. These labels are not verified SNS identities. Other microphone pitch checks store numeric results only. Silence and unclear sound are marked as unmeasured. Microphone access is required to unlock play. Confirm the brief gameplay and microphone notice after tapping unlock; there is no separate invitation consent form.
